pullRequests.author: Veradictus
pullRequests.head: pr/large-functions
pullRequests.body:
Match 780 functions, with compiler and assembler fixes measured against retail
This adds C for 777 v1.01 functions and three release-specific ones, plus the
compiler and assembler changes that got them there. Most of it is large level code:
166 of the functions are over 1 KB, and the biggest are the per-level hero state
handlers (30 to 37 KB each).
It is rebased onto master after #329, #331 and #332. 55 functions were matched both
here and in those PRs, mostly #329's -rc2.c units. Master's…

pullRequests.title: feat(src): mark six DMA wait loops ASM_FUNC
pullRequests.author: DrLegitamate
pullRequests.head: asm/wait-loops-002EEB00
pullRequests.body:
What
Six 40-byte boot bodies in src/game/002EEB00.c marked ASM_FUNC: func_002F1E60, func_002F29E4, func_002F2A0C, func_002F32AC, func_002F32D4, func_002F4F78. Each is the same wait loop on a hardware channel register (-0x3000 or -0x2C00 off $a0):
lw   $at, off($a0)
nop ; nop ; nop
andi $at, $at, 0x100
nop
bnez $at, <self>
nop
jr   $ra
lui  $ra, 0x7000

They use $at as their working register and write $ra in the return's delay slot, which cc1 never emits. This is AGENTS.md's second "Handwritten…
